meaning:
portion, possession, lot
Aramaic of che.leq (חֵ֫לֶק "portion" H2506A)

elsewhere.note: We inform the king that, if this city is built and the walls finished, then you will have no possession beyond the River.
Nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew…
